body_html:
Oh man…this is what I call a Party. Any more fun and the cops would have came. JAMMIN DJ’s made it’s mark on this wedding and it will be one everyone there won’t soon forget! I handed out all my business cards, and there were no shortage of praise. Jammin was exactly what this wedding was from start to finish. Great venue, great food, great wedding…congrats to the new bride and groom

DJ Herb
